resolved_content.description:
Thank you for choosing DPS Jankipuram !

Embarking on the journey to join DPS Jankipuram is a thoughtful process that ensures the right fit for your child’s educational experience. Our admission process is designed to be comprehensive and transparent, providing families with a clear pathway to enrolment. To initiate the journey, prospective parents or guardians are invited to submit an application form, marking the first step towards consideration for admission.

Upon receipt of your application, our dedicated admissions team will guide you through the subsequent steps, including an entrance test and other essential elements of the admission process. We understand the importance of thorough pre-course counselling, and our team is committed to assisting you in making informed decisions about your child’s educational journey at DPS Jankipuram.

items.title: Step 1: Entry Requirement
items.content:
Step 1: Entry Requirement

  • Prospectus can be acquired from the School Office.
  • Application forms are to be filled in and submitted to the Administrative Office.
  • Playgroup Admission: Through Observation/Interaction.

Details of the Entrance Test 

  • Classes PG – II: One-to-One Interaction
  • Note: In selected cases, the Entrance Test may be taken.
  • Classes 3 to 8: Entrance Test will be conducted in English, Hindi & Maths (Test Duration: 2 to 2.5 hours)
  • Classes 9 & 10: Entrance Test will be conducted in English, Hindi, Maths & Science (Test Duration: 2.5 to 3 hours)
  • Classes 11 & 12: Entrance Test will be conducted on the following basis
  • For Science Stream: English, Physics, Chemistry, Maths /Bio (Test Duration: 2.5 to 3 hours)
  • For Commerce Stream: English & Basic Maths (Test Duration: 1.5 hours)
  • For Humanities Stream: English (Test Duration: 1 hour)

 Kindly bring the copies of the following documents along with the Registration Form :

 1. Birth Certificate from the Municipal Corporation/Nagar Nigam.

 2. Aadhar Card of both the parents and the student.

 3. Statement of Marks of the last Test/Exam that the child has appeared for.

(Duly attested by the School Principal only)

items.content:
Step 2: Online Enquiry Form

Please feel free to use the school admission enquiry form below for any information or questions you have for us. We would love to hear from you.

items.title: Step 3: Pay Registration & Application Fee
items.content:
Step 3: Pay Registration & Application Fee

  • You are requested to pay the Registration fee (Rs 1100/-only). 
  • An entrance exam and an interaction will be scheduled
  • Upon selection, admission fee is required to be submitted.

Online Registration

items.title: Step 4: Admission Process - Documents Required
items.content:
Step 4: Admission Process - Documents Required

  • Birth Certificate (From Nagar Nigam)
  • 3 recent passport-size photographs of the child
  • Copy of Aadhar card (parents and child)
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable), PEN from previous school
  • Transfer Certificate or School Leaving Certificate
  • Report card of previous school
  • Medical records (if any)

items.title: Step 5: Pay Quarterly Fee
items.content:
Step 5: Pay Quarterly Fee

Pay the quarterly fees to complete the admission process latest by 15th of the beginning of the quarterly cycle.

items.title: Step 6: Post Admission Process
items.content:
Step 6: Post Admission Process

Once admitted to the school, you’ll receive:

  • Admission Fee Receipt
  • Fee Booklet
  • ERP Login Credentials
  • Bus Route Details (if applicable)
  • Information for Uniform & Book Collection
  • Class & Section Allocation
  • Inclusion in Official Class Groups
